text:
Predicates:
Likes(g, music) ::: George likes music.
WantsToCompose(g) ::: George wants to compose.
HasAccess(g, p) ::: George has access to a program.
CanCompose(g) ::: George can compose.
WillCompose(g) ::: George will compose.
Premises:
Likes(g, music) → WantsToCompose(g) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
HasAccess(g, p) → CanCompose(g) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
CanCompose(g) ∧ WantsToCompose(g) → WillCompose(g) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
¬WillCompose(g) → ¬CanCompose(g) ::: If George will not compose, George can not compose.
